text:
Maya R: FYI SR#23210 — customer reports tool call failing with 400 schema validation for tool \"file_uploader\" after pasting JSON from Windows. @Alex H can you take?

Alex H: on it. can you paste the exact request body they sent (redacted)?

Maya R: sanitized curl the customer used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/file_uploader/call \
 -H \"Authorization: Bearer xxxxx\" \
 -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
 -d '{"path": "C:\\\\Users\\\\kevin\\\\Documents\\\\report.pdf", "meta": {"user":"kevin"},}'
```
Response they got:
```json
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{"error":"tool_args_validation_failed","details":"Trailing comma in object at position 89"}
```

Jordan P: two issues packed together: backslashes not escaped for JSON and trailing comma triggers strict parser fail. many libs will silently accept, ours rejects.

Maya R: quick repro I did locally on Win10 PowerShell:
1) paste the exact curl above and run -> 400 same error
2) change path to use escaped backslashes and remove trailing comma:
   -d '{"path": "C:\\\\Users\\\\kevin\\\\Documents\\\\report.pdf", "meta": {"user":"kevin"}}' -> 200 OK

Alex H: support action items:
- tell customer cause: unescaped backslashes + trailing comma
- quick fixes: escape backslashes (\\\\) or use forward slashes (/) and remove trailing commas
- create eng issue for clearer parser error with offending token/field and consider tolerant parsing behind flag

Jordan P: repro script (python) to validate once patched:
```py
import requests
body = {"path": "C:\\\\Users\\\\kevin\\\\Documents\\\\report.pdf", "meta": {"user": "kevin"}}
r = requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/file_uploader/call", json=body, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer REDACT"})
print(r.status_code, r.text)
```

ops-bot: Escalation created INC-2029 -> assigned to eng-runtime (priority P2). CI job added: repro/edgecases/windows-path-escape.json

QA-bot: Regression test added: tests/toolcalls/windows_path_trailing_comma

Maya R: thanks all, I'll send the customer the recommended fixes and note INC-2029. :thumbsup:

Alex H: draft message to customer:
\"Thanks — root cause is invalid JSON: unescaped backslashes and a trailing comma in the payload. Fixes: escape backslashes (\\\\) or use / for paths, and remove trailing commas. We opened INC-2029 to improve parser errors and evaluate a tolerant parsing flag. If you'd like, we can apply a server-side fix for this SR — let us know.\"

Jordan P: also adding a short note to SDK quickstarts about windows path examples.

Maya R: sending reply to customer now.
